description: interrupt/resume idempotence — a deterministic mid-iteration kill leaves a recordless casualty; a --resume restart skips the already-recorded iterations, re-runs the casualty and the rest, and the strict exact-multiset guard reconciles the final ledger to the protocol replay/small cross-product with 0 dup / 0 gap and exactly one record per iterationId. killC additionally proves resume SKIPS an ALREADY-RECORDED verify_crash STOP (does not re-run it into a proof, no dup / no gap, the stop record preserved byte-identical).
